entries.zh: 奈何；怎么、怎么办（怎奈为何）
entries.en: how so? / what can be done about it? (lit. what thing?)

entries.zh: 是什么、什么东西（是乜物）
entries.en: what (thing) is it? / what thing?

entries.zh: 见教、指教；请赐教
entries.en: please instruct (me); pray, tell me; your advice?

entries.zh: 那是什么事、什么事（亚是乜事）
entries.en: what business/matter is that?

entries.zh: 某件事、某事（某一桩事务）
entries.en: a certain matter; some affair or other
entries.notes: 中字「件」调号污损（T99），按规约定为低置信；字义据汉字与西语词头仍属清楚。

entries.zh: 事路；事情、事务、事由
entries.en: matter; business; the way things stand

entries.zh: 几、几多、多少
entries.en: how many? how much?

entries.zh: 你要什么事、要什么（要是乜事）
entries.en: what do you want?

entries.zh: 有什么见教、有何指教
entries.en: what do you want of me? what is your instruction?

entries.zh: 嗳呀（应答叹词，答「您要什么」之问）
entries.en: interjection of reply: 'ay!' / 'oh!'

entries.zh: 生了什么罪、犯何罪过（告解语境问罪）
entries.en: what sin have you committed? / what deeds?
entries.notes: 第三字「靠」与音写 cua 不合，疑为「过」之形讹或异读，词义依西语 pecado 与「罪」字定。

entries.zh: 这是什么样的人、此人何等样人（是乜色人，原件写「城」）
entries.en: what manner of man is this? of what quality or rank?
entries.notes: 汉字「城」与音写 sia 不合，疑为「啥/色」之转写异体，词义依西语 de calidad 定。

entries.zh: 值哪一日、哪一天
entries.en: on what day? which day?

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西语词头残损（疑 cuántos 类问量语）；汉字「几却」可解作「几多」
entries.en: (original damaged; gloss uncertain) how many / how much ...?
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（?an ?rables?），疑为 cuántos 类问银钱或数量之语；汉字「却」与音写 quep 所指未能定夺。

entries.zh: 做什么、干么（做乜）
entries.en: what to do? / do what? / why?

entries.zh: 奈我何、能把我怎样
entries.en: what can anyone do to me? / what is to be done about me?
entries.notes: 首字「杂」当为「奈」之形讹，据音写 nay 定读「奈我何」。

entries.zh: 知道什么、识得什么（识是乜）
entries.en: what does one know? / what is there to know?
entries.notes: 首字音写 ban 与「识」常音不合（疑为 bat 之讹），词义依西语 saber 与后二字「是乜」定。

entries.zh: 贵造；敬问生辰（生于何朝何年何月）
entries.en: your honored birth-data (horoscope); in what era, year and month were you born?

entries.zh: 执事；执掌之事、尊驾所司（敬语，对应「阁下所欲所命」）
entries.en: your worship's charge or affairs; formula: what do you wish, what do you command, sir?
entries.notes: 汉义「执事」与西语问句对应较松，或为对 vm.（阁下）之敬称、或指对方所办之事。

entries.zh: 何妨、有何妨碍（问有何不便；原文写「何方」）
entries.en: what harm is there? / what is the objection or difficulty?
entries.notes: 「方」疑为「妨」之同音借字，据西语 inconveniente 定读「何妨」；原文亦可按「何方」（何处）解。
